gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai swells its lowercase like inflated glass beads, rounded and left open. Noto Sans Thai feels plump and friendly beside Mystery Quest, whose open-jawed curves and compact ascenders read bookish and nostalgic.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-thai-loop: Tall lowercase bodies make this plain sans look bold, with spacious gaps at the curve terminals. Noto Sans Thai Looped carries the text while Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic, takes the display lines above.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Rounded and inviting, Noto Sans Tifinagh is a plain sans whose lowercase bowls fill the line like inflated shapes. Mystery Quest adds a bookish, nostalgic display voice with compact ascenders above.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Storybook up top, crisp below, with a dominant x-height. Mystery Quest does best at bookish, nostalgic display, its jaws open on every curve, while Noto Sans Tirhuta, a contemporary sans, does best at clean, cut-back text.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic is approachable, letter mouths open like unjoined chalk arcs. Next to Mystery Quest, bookish and nostalgic with compact ascenders, this sans-serif feels like a friendly margin note beside a storybook title.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-vai: Noto Sans Vai sets words as solid blocks, not skylines. Noto Sans Vai, a modern sans-serif with generous space at its curve ends, is best at text, while Mystery Quest is best at bookish, nostalgic display.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Mystery Quest brings bookish, nostalgic charm, with open jaws on every curved stroke. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, a plain sans with open throats and a minimal cap-to-lowercase step, gives the heading a modern, quiet partner.
gen-mystery-quest-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Open jaws on every curved stroke give Mystery Quest its bookish, nostalgic face. And Noto Sans Wancho, a plain sans with hulking, chalk-pressed lowercase and a wide gap at the e terminal, supplies the pair's real punch.
